parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue but may introduce unintended side effects.

issues.description: The change modifies the behavior of the `pytest_runtest_makereport` hook, which could potentially affect other parts of the codebase that rely on this hook. There is a risk of introducing a behavioral regression.

The patch does not include additional tests to verify that the change does not break other scenarios involving test skipping and xfailing. More comprehensive tests are needed to ensure the fix is robust.
